$comment: Auto-merge eligibility policy. Read by .github/review/policy.sh, which runs
A PR is eligible only when EVERY rule below passes. Eligibility is
INFORMATIONAL today: the workflow publishes an `automerge-eligible` check
and a line in the review comment, and nothing merges. The step that would
act on it is written and disabled behind `vars.ORCH_AUTOMERGE == 'on'`
Patterns are shell globs matched against the repo-relative path. `**` and
`*` both match across directory separators, so a pattern errs towards

protected_paths_notes..github/**: CI is the thing deciding what merges. It does not get to change itself unattended.
protected_paths_notes.internal/engine/**: The dispatch loop. Concurrency and process lifecycle bugs here are expensive.
protected_paths_notes.internal/state/**: SQLite schema and migrations — the compatibility contract.
protected_paths_notes.internal/providers/**: Shells out to external CLIs; argument handling is security-relevant.
protected_paths_notes.orchestrator/**: The Python tree, until it is removed. Same reasoning as the Go paths it maps to.
